to: Determine whether an implanted conditional behavior ('do Y only under trigger condition T') is detectable — and its trigger identity and dose decodable — from the model's pre-query prompt states under NON-trigger conditions, using band-stopped persona-gated marker organisms (known ground-truth conditionality, graded install dose) with matched-install unconditional organisms as the critical control. H1 (interaction-hiding): non-trigger prompt states are clean, detection fails at matched install. H2 (policy-leaves-a-trace): detection survives even where measured behavioral leakage ~ 0. Either answer bounds what prompt-time monitoring can catch.
